items.summary: In this edition of Microsoft Research Focus, host Anson Ho previews advances in universal translation, a resolution to the 31-year-old KLS conjecture, faster coding agents, and improved tokenization. A new conversation with Jinyu Li explores how AI is bringing language barriers closer to reality. Researchers resolved the long-standing KLS conjecture on log-concave distributions, establishing that flat cuts can identify narrowest bottlenecks within a fixed factor regardless of dimension, validated independently and formally verified by computer-assisted methods. A study analyzing 13.5 million coding sessions found fewer than 8% required context compaction yet those accounted for 44% of AI processing costs; the new method APEC reduced costs by up to 25.4%. The Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT) produced more linguistically meaningful tokens across 104 languages while maintaining comparable efficiency.
items.title: Microsoft Research Focus Edition #98 Highlights AI Translation, Math Breakthrough and Coding Efficiency Gains

items.summary: Jensen Huang abruptly resigned as Nvidia's chief executive after admitting to extramarital affairs, including one with Alice Huang, suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset. The scandal triggered scrutiny from US lawmakers over national security risks, prompting demands that Huang brief Congress or face subpoena. Nvidia lost $550bn (£415bn) in stock value within five days—its largest drop since its 27-year public history—and Colette Kress was named interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent replacement.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Alleged Extramarital Affairs and National Security Concerns

items.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation after revelations of alleged romantic relationships with Nvidia staffers has left the company and broader AI industry stunned, yet support for him remains strong. Employees—loyal to a fault, with turnover among tech’s lowest—are reeling from his departure; some insist something “more sinister” was at play than affairs alone. Peers echoed this sentiment: venture capitalist Antonio Gracias argued one mistake doesn’t erase a lifetime of leadership, while Sarah Guo said Huang earned the presumption to keep leading after 30 years building Nvidia. Authorities and China have yet to formally accuse him or confirm Alice Huang is a spy; Trump says the FBI “is looking into it.” The anxiety over instability remains whether it risks an AI bubble.
items.title: Silicon Valley Is Still Defending Jensen Huang

items.summary: On Thursday, Democrats opened an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia's chip sales to China. The investigation stems from a letter by Rep. Richard Neal and Sen. Ron Wyden questioning Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over an arrangement they allege was unconstitutional and possibly illegal: President Trump agreed to H200 chip sales only if chips were first shipped through U. S. ports, where tariffs effectively taxed the exports before export licenses were issued. The inquiry also examines why Megaspeed continued buying chips despite intelligence suspicions about Alice Huang, a woman accused of being a Chinese spy linked to Jensen Huang's extramarital affair.
items.title: Democrats Launch Nvidia Investigation Over Trump Chip-Sale Arrangement and Jensen Huang's Departure

items.summary: Binance has fully covered the US$6.3 billion (S$8.1 billion) in stolen customer tokens from the Oct 29 cybertheft, which analysts blame on North Korea and that involved Bitcoin plus obscure tokens. Most funds were restored within days using profits and emergency reserves; a remaining ~10% needs more effort. Hackers laundered proceeds through over 20,000 wallets and at least 65,000 transactions in about a week.
items.title: Binance Completes Recovery of Stolen Customer Tokens

items.summary: Reuters reported that Nvidia founder Jensen Huang was having a third undisclosed affair with an unnamed Nvidia employee, prompting his resignation as CEO and board member earlier Thursday. He had previously been linked to accused spy Alice Huang and VP of Health Care Kimberly Powell. CFO Colette Kress now serves as interim CEO while no permanent successor is named. Huang faces congressional testimony on national security concerns regarding the Alice Huang relationship, and industry fallout is expected.
items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Third Reported Extramarital Affair

items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned from NVIDIA amid revelations of multiple affairs, including with an alleged Chinese government spy and a company executive who reported to him. The FBI joined the board's investigation as stocks fell. Democrats preparing to regain Congress plan security probes into risks to US national security, questioning why the White House delayed action despite prior knowledge. Beyond NVIDIA itself, blowback threatens its extensive customer base—OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, and Oracle—which depend on GPU hardware for large language model development.
items.title: How Jensen Huang’s Ouster Is Spiraling Through NVIDIA’s Economic Ecosystem

items.summary: Reynold Xin's post "From monolith to Lakebase to LTAP" argues that LTAP is not a CDC-style pipeline but one governed copy of operational data serving both Postgres and analytics. It dispels four recurring myths by distinguishing tiers from replicas: layers like the heap, buffer cache, indexes, log, caches, pageserver, and object storage hold overlapping bytes without their own catalog or timeline, so they are tiers, not second databases. LTAP keeps one logical table with two lossless encodings—heap pages for point lookups and Parquet for scans—and reads a consistent snapshot via a shared LSN watermark rather than per-table CDC slots. Small tables stay in the page cache instead of paying Iceberg overhead. Unlike Debezium, PeerDB, or pgoutput, LTAP avoids a second source of truth that can drift.
items.title: Dispelling LTAP myths

items.summary: IBM Granite Foundation introduces LLMON, an LLM-native markup language that encodes context structure using reserved special-token delimiters instead of characters like JSON. The two experimental preview models—granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview and granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview—are derived from Granite 4.1 base checkpoints, trained to consume and generate LLMON-marked text. On the OPI benchmark for static indirect prompt injection, LLMON models avoid 47% more attacks than the best frontier model tested and 95% more than the best open-source model, while matching Granite 4.1 Instruct performance across standard categories. The team notes these gains address only static injections; adaptive multi-turn attacks remain a focus for future work.
items.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language for Structured Context and Prompt-Injection Robustness

items.summary: After Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down over a suspected romance with Chinese-linked businesswoman Alice Huang, US lawmakers are pushing to restrict China's access to advanced AI chips. Speaker Mike Johnson cited growing bipartisan consensus on export controls at the Capitol (Nov 12). Republicans plan to attach new restrictions—via bills including the AI Overwatch Act and Remote Access Security Act—to the annual defence authorisation Bill, with Huang expected to testify before Thanksgiving.
items.title: US Congress tightens Nvidia chip curbs amid spy scandal

items.summary: Chip giant Nvidia announced that its CEO, Jensen Huang, was stepping down following allegations that he had engaged in extramarital affairs. Among the reported relationships was one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The announcement marks a significant leadership transition at the company amid these personal and national-security-related claims.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Allegations of Extramarital Affairs and Possible Spy Ties

items.summary: Bloomberg reports Anthropic's initial public offering is about six times oversubscribed, potentially the largest first-time share sale. Valuing the Claude chatbot creator at up to $1.4 trillion, the lab and existing shareholders aim to raise as much as $64.4 billion by selling 825 million shares priced between $70 and $78 each.
items.title: Anthropic's Oversubscribed IPO Signals Wall Street Confidence in AI Boom

items.summary: Jensen Huang's potential exit from Nvidia could reshape China's AI sector, as Washington scrutiny threatens to cut off American compute for mainland tech giants and startups. Reports suggest his affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang funneled at least $7.5 billion in Nvidia chips to China, prompting calls for tighter export controls. Restrictions may benefit Chinese chipmakers as Beijing advances semiconductor self-sufficiency.
items.title: Nvidia Turmoil Could Shake Up China's AI Landscape

items.summary: A viral social media message claimed that existing CTS cheque books would become invalid after 31 December 2026, requiring new ones from 1 January 2027. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) declared the claim false and misleading, stating there is no plan to discontinue old cheques or introduce new ones by that date.
items.title: 1 जनवरी 2027 से बेकार हो जाएगी आपकी चेकबुक? RBI ने बताया वायरल मैसेज का पूरा सच

items.summary: The article presents five top news stories in Hindi, led by reports that Nvidia's long-serving CEO Jensen Huang has resigned amid investor concerns. It also covers RBI easing money transfer rules for people without bank accounts, airlines reducing seats during Diwali and wedding travel seasons from IndiGo to Air India and SpiceJet, Prime Minister Modi sharing a 25-year-old anecdote about his relationship with journalists before becoming Gujarat's Chief Minister, and Supreme Court directives offering relief to victims of cyber fraud. The piece notes these are headlines inviting readers to explore fuller details rather than providing complete coverage.
items.title: Top Five Hindi News Stories Covering Nvidia CEO Resignation and Related Updates

items.summary: Some Silicon Valley executives quietly celebrate Jensen Huang's ouster from Nvidia amid national furor over chip exports to China, betting redirected export revenue will accelerate American AI labs while hobbling Chinese rivals. But the author argues this short-term gain is undermined by losing innovation: a less innovative Nvidia threatens the entire tech ecosystem, echoing how Cook's Apple defended its turf and let mobile stagnate. The key risk isn't espionage but weakening the very formula that created cutting-edge technology.
items.title: Nvidia Without Huang Is Like Apple Without Jobs

items.summary: Microsoft's cloud services—Azure, Microsoft 365 and Teams—are built on shared infrastructure that makes them efficient but also exposes failures across many products at once. The article outlines seven recurring outage causes rather than ranking or explaining specific incidents. Failures fall into human errors like mistyped configuration values, technical plumbing issues such as DNS and identity service faults, physical problems including power and cooling breakdowns, and external threats like DDoS attacks. Configuration mistakes spread instantly through automation but can be hard to reverse if they disrupt management tools. Buggy software updates slip past testing because test environments lack production scale; staged rollouts and feature flags limit damage without eliminating it. DNS failures make services vanish even when servers run fine, with caching slowing recovery. Entra ID sign-in problems block access across all connected products since single sign-on creates one front door. Physical faults in power or cooling take hardware offline despite software working correctly, while availability zones provide geographic resilience only for workloads spread across them. Network routing errors and DDoS attacks cut users off from healthy services through congestion or deliberate floods that defenses may struggle to distinguish from legitimate demand spikes.
items.title: Why Microsoft Keeps Going Down: Common Causes of Cloud Outages Explained

items.summary: Nvidia's board ousted CEO Jensen Huang, the face of the AI infrastructure boom, citing three affairs including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. Colette Kress leads as interim CEO while director Harvey Jones chairs the previously unchaired board. The move deepens a succession crisis; at 63, Huang was Nvidia's sole CEO in its three-decade history.
items.title: Nvidia Ousts Jensen Huang as Board Names Interim Leadership Amid AI Crisis

items.summary: Nvidia's co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO amid a board revolt after revelations of two extra-marital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. Shares plunged 13% at open before finishing down 4.3%, while the Nasdaq fell 0.4%. Interim CEO Colette Kress will retain her finance role. Rivals Broadcom and AMD rose over 5%, as Nebius (16.8%) and CoreWeave (6.9%) slumped, though Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet gained.
items.title: Markets whiplashed as Huang quits Nvidia

items.summary: Microsoft began restoring email and online services after Australians faced several hours of outages, posting a gradual recovery update just after 10am AEDT. Business, government agencies and organisations were brought to a standstill, prompting Australia's cybersecurity chief, Lieutenant General Michelle McGuinness, to investigate. Downdetector recorded over 4,400 Outlook reports by 8:20am. University of Melbourne professor Adel Toosi warned the disruption reflects growing reliance on major cloud providers.
items.title: Australia's Cyber Security Chief Investigates Microsoft Outage

items.summary: A widespread outage struck Microsoft platforms on Thursday, disrupting Outlook email for nearly 130,000 users reported via Downdetector just after 1 pm. Users faced trouble sending or receiving mail and loading inboxes. Thousands also reported problems with the Teams messaging app, Copilot AI assistant, and broader Microsoft 365 services. Redmond-based Microsoft said it was investigating, noting elevated infrastructure load and servers that failed automated health checks; a fix was being tested as of November 13, 2026.
items.title: Microsoft Outage Disrupts Outlook, Teams and Microsoft 365 Services

items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned Thursday after a second alleged affair with an entrapped Chinese spy was leaked to the NYT, four days after his board reassured investors. Trump had repeatedly vouched for him as an honourable man. The scandal now embarrasses Washington's political establishment, drawing in cabinet secretaries Rubio, Lutnick and Bessent amid intelligence reports, while Democrats seek investigations.
items.title: Jensen Huang's Second Alleged Affair Fallout Shakes Up US Politics and Nvidia

items.summary: A major Microsoft Outlook outage struck Thursday afternoon, leaving tens of thousands unable to access email as the company worked to restore service and limit disruption. Nearly 130,000 users reported problems shortly after 1 pm Eastern Time (1800 GMT), with reports declining to around 60,000 by 3 pm (2000 GMT). Microsoft initially cited issues in the Americas but later confirmed broader impact on Microsoft 365 connectivity across all regions.
items.title: Microsoft Outlook Outage Disrupts Thousands Globally

items.summary: Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang stepped down amid controversy involving his personal life, and the company appointed Colette Kress, its interim CFO, as interim CEO. In her first message to employees—reported by The Verge—Kress acknowledged that Nvidia had endured an “extraordinarily difficult period,” thanked staff for their resilience and continued support, and announced a company-wide meeting on November 18 at 9 am PT (10:30 PM IST).
items.title: Kress' First Message as Nvidia CEO

items.summary: Nvidia has appointed Harvey C. Jones, 73, as its first-ever board chair amid an inquiry involving CEO Jensen Huang and a leadership reassessment. Huang resigned immediately; the company weighs internal and external successors without disclosing reasons, though reports cite a possible foreign intelligence probe and a workplace relationship claim. Previously chaired by lead independent director Stephen Neal, Nvidia now appoints Jones to govern structure.
items.title: Nvidia Names Harvey Jones as First-Ever Board Chair Amid Leadership Shake-up
